newsitem.title: USA: CME delays until March 10 listing '98 pork bellies.
newsitem.headline: CME delays until March 10 listing '98 pork bellies.

text.p: Chicago Mercantile Exchange directors this week delayed until March 10 the listing of 1998 pork belly futures contracts, a CME official said.

Directors are awaiting an answer from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission regarding the exchange's request to change to a cash-settled fresh pork belly contract from the current delivery-settled frozen contract, the official said.
The exchange submitted the request to the CFTC late last year, said the official, who asked not to be identified. He said the CME expects to hear from the CFTC on the request by March 10.
Normally, the 1998 pork belly contracts would be listed now.
If the CFTC approves the changes, CME directors would then have the option to change to a cash-settled fresh contract or keep the contracts as they are, the official said.
